description: This file contains helper functions and test procedures for testing Git commit-graph functionality, including cache initialization, graph mode comparisons, and read expectations.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Initializes the OID cache with specified OID versions.

methods.name: graph_git_two_modes
methods.description: Performs Git operations in two commit-graph modes and compares output.

methods.name: graph_git_behavior
methods.description: Checks that Git traversal operations produce consistent results with and without commit-graph.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Sets up expected output for reading commit-graph data and verifies against actual output.
